text.title: Seven chapters, about 50 minutes
text.body:
The clock | thirteen 30-minute windows, and a star at each decision
Entries after the open | the SSC rule, the entry stack, the wiggle
Managing the trade | the PSAR as the leash, adds on the market's money
Chop | the Z3 lines inside one frog box
Three minutes, thirty minutes | growing a trade, core and turbo
VWAP and the close | the magnet, boxes to the VWAP
Tomorrow's list | continuations, the seven patterns, 5DD
